PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'if git diff --name-only | grep -E "\.rs$"; then cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --message-format=short -q; fi'
bash -c 'if git diff --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$"; then npm run --prefix web typecheck; fi'

PreToolUse.command: python3 -c 'import sys, json; cmd = sys.argv[1]; sys.exit(1 if any(b in cmd for b in ["rm -rf /", "ros2 node kill -a"]) else 0)'
